videos.author: @aianimecrew
videos.description: #onepiece #kizaru #agendapiece #slander #anime Kizaru genuinely might be the most overqualified employee in the history of the Marines. This mf possesses the power of light, can travel at literal light speed, casually destroys buildings and has enough destructive capability to turn an entire island into a historical document, yet somehow spends his entire working day looking like he's waiting for his lunch break. 😭 Imagine being Fleet Admiral and having an employee capable of arriving at any emergency before the emergency actually happens, only for him to show up 3 business hours later asking if anyone has seen his sunglasses. Bro is literally made of light but communicates at the speed of a Windows 98 loading screen. The funniest part is that whenever Kizaru actually gets serious, everybody suddenly remembers this mf is one of the most terrifying Marines alive, but until that moment he's moving around like an uncle who got dragged to a family gathering against his will. Akainu is probably sitting in his office dealing with 700 pages of paperwork while Kizaru is out here completing missions with the enthusiasm of somebody being asked to cover an extra shift. Imagine getting paid an Admiral salary, having one of the most broken Devil Fruits in existence and still treating every assignment like a mildly inconvenient commute. This man could literally finish his entire workload before breakfast yet somehow manages to make every interaction feel like he's waiting for somebody else to clock out first. Even the Pacifistas probably have more urgency in their programming. At this point the Marines don't need to recruit more soldiers, they need to install a productivity update into Kizaru's brain. (bro has infinite speed and zero urgency)
